The [[Zaishen Bounty]] [[signpost]] is an [[NPC]] that offers a different daily [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]] for gold, title points, experience, and [[Copper Zaishen Coin]]s. You can get the quest rewards from [[Zehnchu]] at the [[Great Temple of Balthazar]] or [[Embark Beach]].

==Locations==
*[[The Battle Isles]]
**{{NPC location|Embark Beach}}
**{{NPC location|Great Temple of Balthazar}}

==Quests==
* The current available quest, as of {{#time: H:i, j F Y }} (UTC), is [[ {{Cycle|ZBounty|+1}} (Zaishen quest)]].

The available quest changes daily, based on a recurring cycle. For a quick overview of which quests will be available in the next days, see [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]]s. For all available quests, see the [[:Category:Zaishen Bounty quests|category listing]] and for information about the current or previous cycles, see the [[Zaishen Bounty/cycles|cycles subpage]].

==Dialogue==
===[[Roleplaying character|PvE characters]]===
:"''This is the signpost where Zaishen Bounty quests are posted.''"

Alternative with no quests available:
:"''There are no more quests available here today, but other signs may have more postings from the Zaishen.''"

Alternative when you already have the maximum number of bounties:
:"''Zaishen bounties are limited to 3 at one time.''"

When asked about a quest:
:"''This despicable villain still stalks the land, preying on the innocent. Heroes who are up to the challenge should seek this fiend out, taking blood as payment for a life of atrocious deeds.''"

===[[PvP-only character|PvP characters]]===
:"''The signpost speaks of far off lands which you have no interest in as a PvP Character.''" {{sic|"Character" is capitalized}}

== Notes ==
{{bug|A [[character]] will lose the opportunity to take a quest the next time it appears in the cycle if after accepting the quest reward and before the next time that quest appears in the cycle that character does not change [[district]]s, [[zone]], nor [[Log Out|log out]] and log back in.}}
